pilot: 16-team 262144-step four-expert top-2 MoE matched by training seed, frozen in all conditions
training: 16 learner x 8 frozen BC opposing teams; each of 32 balanced passes covers all 128 matchup pairs once; alternate seat per pairing across passes. Four independently sampled lineups share the opponent preview, simulator seed and action-sampling seeds.
model: Frozen native BC actor features and legal logits at both ordered pair selections; a 256 -> 64 tanh -> 12 zero-output residual modifies six slots per active position. A value head on the initial preview estimates the terminal reward. Outcome +1/0/-1, half critic and half matched leave-one-out baseline.
evaluation: Same reciprocal 4 x 8 held-out schedule and deployment sampling as the 16-team study. Full native and learned, plus opponent tokens zeroed for both selectors only at preview. Primary full learned minus full native, diagnostic full gain minus blinded gain. Paired 6000-draw crossed bootstrap. No held-out checkpoint selection.
